verdict.rationale: incident.io documents declaring incidents directly from Slack or Microsoft Teams. It also references a per-incident channel (updates and discussion land 'in your incident channel'), automatic Teams meetings per incident, and AI-drafted updates, so the core chat-driven flow is clearly delivered. However, automatic channel creation is only implied, and role assignment is not evidenced at all. Missing for 10: any evidence of incident roles being assigned or created, explicit documentation that a dedicated channel is auto-created on declaration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me

citations.quote: Declaring an incident takes seconds, and you can do it right from where your team already works, whether that's Slack or Microsoft Teams.
Connect pull requests and get updates in your incident channel.
Automatically start a Microsoft Teams meeting for each incident.
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
the median time from an incident opening to an accurate message arriving in channel having gone from 6.7 to 3 minutes
